name: FTBSkies2
description: FTB Skies 2 Modded Minecraft Server FTB Skies 2 FTB Skies 2 is the sequel to the original floating-island survival experience. This updated modpack blends high-tech automation with new magical mechanics, offering an immersive world of quests, challenges, and creativity. Setup: [li]Accept the EULA by setting the EULA variable to true . Optional: [li]Add server operators via the OPS variable (comma-separated usernames).
